content: Yisaaqa Yeleteth
GODAY Saara qoppides; kase izis yootida malakka ooththides.
Saaray shaarada cimateththan Abrahaames Xoossi gida wodey gakkiin attuma naa yeladus.
Saaray izas yelida naaza sunththaa Abrahaamey, «Yisaaqa» gi sunththides.
Abrahaamey naaza Yisaaqa Xoossi bana azazida mala yelettidaappe osppunththa gallas qaxxarides.
Iza naa Yisaaqi izas yelettida wode Abrahaames layththay xeeta.
Saaray, «Xoossi tana miichchides; qasse hayssa siyizay wuri tanara miiccana» gadus.
Qasseka Saaray, «Abrahaames Saaray naa yelananne dhanththana giidi qoppiday oonee? Gidikkoka tani ha7i izas izi cimmida woden naa yeladis» gadus.
Aggaaronne Isma7eele Goodeteth
Guuththa naazi diccidi dhanth duuxxides; Yisaaqi dhanththafe duuxxida gallas Abrahaamey gita diggisa diggisides.
Gibxeppe yida Aggaara Abrahaames yelida naazi Isma7eeley Yisaaqa leqqizayssa Saaray be7ada,
Abrahaame, «Hanno aylley naazi ta naa Yisaaqara mulekka laattontta gishshas aylleyonne izi naaza kessa goodda» gadus.
Ha yo7ozi ba naaza bochchiza gishshas Abrahaamey daroppe metotettides.
Gido attiin Xoossi Abrahaame, «Ne zereththay Yisaaqa baggara xeygettanayssa gishshas aylley gishshassinne izi naaza gishshas daro metotoppa; Saaray nees yootizayssa ubbaa siya.
Qasse tani izi ne zereth gidida gishshas aylley naaza kawoteth histtana» gides.
Abrahaamey maalado wonttara dendidi guuththa kaththinne koddan haath ekkidi Aggaaro hashen toossidi izi naazakka izis immidi kessi yeddides; iza baada Bersaabehe geetettiza bazzon toylattadus.

Haaththayka koddaafe wuriin iza, «Ta naazi hayqqishin uttada ta iza be7ikke» gaada naaza buura garsan woththada 200 wadha gidizaso mala baada heen uttadus; heenkka izakko simma uttada ba qaala dhoqqu histta yeekkadus.
Xoossi naaza waaso siyides; saloppe Xoossa kiitanchchay Aggaaro xeygidi, «Aggaaree! Waanadii? Xoossi naazi ichchidason yeekkizayssa siyida gishshas babbofa;
denda eqqa; naaza denththada ne kushen oykka; tani iza gita kawoteth histtana» gides.
Xoossi izis haaththa olla bessiin baada koddan haath kunththadus; naazakka ushshadus.
Xoossi naazara dees; naazikka diccidi bazzo biittan wondafe dukkiza as gidides.
Izi Paaraane bazzon de7ishin iza aaya izas machcho Gibxeppe ekkadus.
Abrahaamenne Abimelekke Caaqo
He wode Abimelekkey ba wottadarata halaqa Pikoolera Abrahaamekko biidi, «Neni ooththiza ubbaan Xoossi nenara dees.

Neni ta bolla woykko ta nayta bolla woykko ta zereththa bolla baleththon gene ooththontta mala ha7i hayssan Xoossa sinththan taas caaqqa; tani nees ne kiyidayssaththo nenikka taassinne neni imaththateththan diza hayssa biittazas lo7o ooththa» gides.
Abrahaamey, «Tani caaqqays» gides.
He wode Abrahaamey Abimelekke aylleti ekkida haaththa olla gishshas Abimelekkes magannides.
Gido attiin Abimelekkey, «Hessa ooni ooththidaakko tani erikke; nenikka qasse taas yootabeekka; tani hach gakkanaas hessa siyabeekke» gides.
Hessafe guye Abrahaamey dorsatanne miizata ehidi Abimelekkes immiin istti nam7ay caaqettida.
Abrahaamey meheta giddofe laappun uzzi dorsata shaakkides.
Abimelekkey Abrahaame, «Ha neni shaakkida laappun uzzota ays shaakkadii?» gi oychchides.
Abrahaamey, «Tani hayssa haaththa ollaa bookkidayssas markka gidana mala hayta laappun uzzota taappe ekka» gides.
Heen he nam7u asati caaqettida gishshas he sohoy Bersaabehe
geetettides.
Bersaabehen caaqo caaqettidayssafe guye Abimelekkeynne iza wottadarata halaqa Pikooley dendidi Filisxeeme biitta simmida.
Abrahaamey Bersaabehen Tamarssike geetettiza mith tokkidi heen GODAA Mernaa Xoossa xeygidi goynnides.
Abrahaamey Filisxeeme biittan daro wode imaththateththan de7ides.

footnotes.text: Bersaabehe: Bersaabehe guussi Ibraaweta qaalara, «Caaqo haaththa olla woykko Laappun Haaththa Olla» guussa.
Tamarssike geetettiza miththay izas geesay qaanth gidishin zambafe dummatiza miththa
